specialty.name: Rumors
specialty.summary: He hears things: extra clues, and the hacker feud, the cat.

voice.vouch.a: Wren sent you, and Wren sends me everyone, because I know everyone. I know whose pipe leaks, who is behind on rent and who is in the wrong building. Naturally I know about you.
voice.vouch.b: Of course I will, love. Come by whenever. I will have heard something by then, I always have.
voice.first_lesson.a: Lesson one. Nobody ever tells a secret, they tell a story and hope you work out the secret. Listen for what a person is careful not to say. The cat is missing, the hackers have fallen out, and old Dov is in love with a form. All of it is true. Some of it is useful.
voice.first_lesson.b: Wait a day and ask me again. A rumour is like a loaf: best the day after. And if you need a name, a door or a pipe, I am the one to ask.
voice.slip.a: Oh! Alder, that cardigan suits you. Oh. I have no idea why I said that.
voice.slip.b: Nobody at all. I am a chatterbox and my tongue ran ahead of me. Forget it.
voice.refusal.a: Please, dear, do not ask me where I heard it. I do not remember. I truly do not, and that frightens me more than anything.
voice.refusal.warm: Come and sit with me. You are the best thing that has happened to this building.
voice.refusal.steady: I will not ask again. Tea, whenever you want.
voice.shake.a: I asked around about the Gate. Everyone I know has a cousin who went to it. Nobody knows anyone who came back. Nobody ever asked how it knew them. I have collected rumours for forty years and this is the first one that is not funny.
voice.shake.opt: The Gate cannot be passed by anyone it knows.
voice.shake.b: Then it is the one door in the city with no gossip behind it. You will need a story it has never heard. I know quite a few.
voice.choice.a: This whole building is my family, you know. Half of them would be lost without me. I have to decide whether to go or to stay.
voice.choice.leave_b: Then I will go, and I will tell everyone I know, quietly. They will hear it by morning. They always do.
voice.choice.stay_b: Then I will stay and keep the building warm, and tell the story right when you are gone.
voice.awakening.a: I remembered where I heard the name. Not from a rumour. From you. You told me once, in the stairwell, years ago. I have been carrying it ever since without knowing.
voice.awakening.b: Alder. You said it was a good name for someone who meant to be forgotten. I am sorry I did not say so. I am so glad you came back.
voice.out: Mind the stairs, they have opinions.
voice.companion.a: I have said goodbye to every neighbour and told them it was a cold. Ask me and I will go. I will even be quiet about it, mostly.
voice.companion.b: Then I will go, and I will tell you everything on the way, whether you want it or not.
